        (((l.take i).map fun x => (x.2 : A)).prod * d (l[i].2 : A) *
          ((l.drop (i + 1)).map fun x => (x.2 : A)).prod)

theorem mapAddMonoidHom_mk (f : M →+ N)

    (hd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n (mk M n z) = mk N n (cocycles.mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n z)

name: DG.cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf
statement:
theorem mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf (f : M →+ N)
    (hmem : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hdm : d m = 0) :
    mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n (mkOf hm hdm) =
      mkOf (hmem hm) (by rw [← hd, hdm, map_zero])

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_apply
statement:
theorem merge_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (k : Fin n) :
    merge i a k = if (k : ℕ) < i then a k.castSucc
      else if (k : ℕ) = i then a k.castSucc * a k.succ else a k.succ

statement:

    merge (Fin.last n).succ a (Fin.last (n + 1)) =
      a (Fin.last (n + 1)).castSucc * a (Fin.last (n + 2))

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_last_apply_zero
statement: theorem merge_last_apply_zero : merge (Fin.last n).succ a 0 = a 0

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_mem_grading
DG.Hochschild.merge_merge
statement:
theorem merge_merge {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 3) → A) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2))
    (h : (i : ℕ) < j) :
    merge i (merge j a) = merge ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ (merge i.castSucc a)

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_succ_apply_last
statement:
theorem merge_succ_apply_last (i : Fin n) :
    merge i.castSucc.succ a (Fin.last (n + 1)) = a (Fin.last (n + 2))

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_succ_apply_zero
statement: theorem merge_succ_apply_zero (i : Fin n) : merge i.castSucc.succ a 0 = a 0

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_castSucc
statement:
theorem merge_update_castSucc {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (x : A) :
    merge i (Function.update a i.castSucc x) =
      Function.update (merge i a) i (x * a i.succ)

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_of_gt
statement:
theorem merge_update_of_gt {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : A)
    (h : (i : ℕ) + 1 < p) :
    merge i (Function.update a p x) = Function.update (merge i a) ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩ x

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_of_lt
statement:
theorem merge_update_of_lt {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : A)
    (h : (p : ℕ) < i) :
    merge i (Function.update a p x) = Function.update (merge i a) ⟨p, by omega⟩ x

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_succ
statement:
theorem merge_update_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (x : A) :
    merge i (Function.update a i.succ x) =
      Function.update (merge i a) i (a i.castSucc * x)

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_zero_apply_last
statement: theorem merge_zero_apply_last : merge 0 a (Fin.last (n + 1)) = a (Fin.last (n + 2))

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_zero_apply_zero
statement: theorem merge_zero_apply_zero : merge 0 a 0 = a 0 * a 1

name: DG.hochschildD_comp_hochschildD
statement:
theorem hochschildD_comp_hochschildD (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    hochschildD (R := R) (A := A) (M := M) k (n + 1) ∘ₗ hochschildD k n = 0

name: DG.hochschildD_mem
DG.hochschildD_zero_apply
statement:
theorem hochschildD_zero_apply (k : ℤ) (f : HochschildCochain R A M 0) (a : Fin 1 → A) :
    hochschildD k 0 f a = DGAlgebra.twist R A k (a 0) • f 0 - op (a 0) • f 0

name: DG.hochschildDiff_apply
statement:
theorem hochschildDiff_apply (k : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    hochschildDiff k f a = DGAlgebra.twist R A k (a 0) • f (Fin.tail a) +
      ∑ i : Fin n, koszulSign ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ) • f (merge i a) +
        koszulSign ((n : ℤ) + 1) • (op (a (Fin.last n)) • f (Fin.init a))

name: DG.hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff
statement:
theorem hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff (k : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) :
    hochschildDiff k (hochschildDiff k f) = 0

name: DG.hochschildTotalD_apply_zero
statement:
theorem hochschildTotalD_apply_zero (N : ℤ) (f : hochschildTotal R A M N) :

name: DG.hochschildTotalD_hochschildTotalD
statement:
theorem hochschildTotalD_hochschildTotalD (N : ℤ) (f : hochschildTotal R A M N) :

name: DG.mem_gradedCenter
statement:
theorem mem_gradedCenter {k : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ gradedCenter R A M k ↔ m ∈ grading k ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (a : A), a ∈ grading p → op a • m = koszulSign (p * k) • (a • m)

name: DG.mem_gradedCenter_self_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gradedCenter_self_iff {k : ℤ} {z : A} :
    z ∈ gradedCenter R A A k ↔ z ∈ grading k ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (a : A), a ∈ grading p → z * a = koszulSign (p * k) • (a * z)

name: DG.mem_hochschildCochains
statement:
theorem mem_hochschildCochains {k : ℤ} {n : ℕ} {f : HochschildCochain R A M n} :
    f ∈ hochschildCochains R A M k n ↔ ∀ (p : Fin n → ℤ) (a : Fin n → A),
      (∀ i, a i ∈ grading (p i)) → f a ∈ grading (k + ∑ i, p i)

name: DG.GradedOpposite.decompose_mulHom
statement:

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_assoc
statement:
theorem mulAux_assoc (x y z : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_lof_lof
statement:
theorem mulAux_lof_lof (i j : ℤ) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : 𝒜 j) :
    mulAux 𝒜 (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) i a) (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) j b) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) j b * lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) i a)

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_of_of
statement:
theorem mulAux_of_of (i j : ℤ) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : 𝒜 j) :
    mulAux 𝒜 (of (𝒜 ·) i a) (of (𝒜 ·) j b) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (of (𝒜 ·) j b * of (𝒜 ·) i a)

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_one
statement: theorem mulAux_one (x : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) : mulAux 𝒜 x 1 = x

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_smul_left
statement:
theorem mulAux_smul_left (s : ℤ) (x y : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_smul_right
statement:
theorem mulAux_smul_right (s : ℤ) (x y : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_assoc

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_of_mem

theorem mulHom_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j) :

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_one
statement: theorem mulHom_one (a : A) : mulHom 𝒜 a 1 = a

name: DG.GradedOpposite.one_mulAux

    ∃ s t : R, s ∈ S ∧ t ∈ T ∧ s + t = g ∧ IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsIdempotentElem t ∧

      ∃ l : List R, (∀ e ∈ l, e ∈ 𝒜 0 ∧ IsIdempotentElem e ∧ IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e) ∧

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_hidem
statement:
theorem augment_hidem : ∀ x, eqToHom (P.augment_hobj σ τ hobj x).symm ≫
    σ.map (P.augment.idem x) ≫ eqToHom (P.augment_hobj σ τ hobj x) =
      P.augment.idem (Sum.map σ.obj τ x)
  | .inl X => by
    change eqToHom _ ≫ σ.map (𝟙 X) ≫ eqToHom _ = 𝟙 (σ.obj X)
    erw [eqToHom_refl]
    simp
  | .inr i => hidem i

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_hobj
statement:

  | .inl _ => rfl
  | .inr i => hobj i

name: DG.Cochain.comp_add

    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (z₁ + z₁') h = z₂.comp z₁ h + z₂.comp z₁' h

name: DG.Cochain.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (x : M) : z₂.comp z₁ h x = z₂ (z₁ x)

name: DG.Cochain.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {n₁ n₂ n₃ n₁₂ n₂₃ n₁₂₃ : ℤ}
    (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂) (z₃ : Cochain A P Q n₃)
    (h₁₂ : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (h₂₃ : n₂ + n₃ = n₂₃) (h₁₂₃ : n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃) :
    z₃.comp (z₂.comp z₁ h₁₂) (show n₁₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃ by rw [← h₁₂, h₁₂₃]) =
      (z₃.comp z₂ h₂₃).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₂₃, ← h₁₂₃, add_assoc])

statement:

name: DG.δ_apply'
statement:
theorem δ_apply' (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain A M N n) (x : M) :
    δ n m z x = d (z x) + koszulSign m • z (d x)

name: DG.δ_comp
statement:
theorem δ_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (m₁ m₂ m₁₂ : ℤ) (h₁₂ : n₁₂ + 1 = m₁₂) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁)
    (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₁₂ m₁₂ (z₂.comp z₁ h) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₂, ← h, add_assoc]) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁)
          (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₁, ← h, add_assoc, add_comm 1, add_assoc])

name: DG.δ_comp_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_ofHom {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n) (f : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((Cochain.ofHom f).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (Cochain.ofHom f).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)

name: DG.δ_comp_zero_cochain
statement:
theorem δ_comp_zero_cochain {n₁ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P 0)
    (m₁ : ℤ) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁) :
    δ n₁ m₁ (z₂.comp z₁ (add_zero n₁)) =
      (δ 0 1 z₂).comp z₁ h₁ + z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁) (add_zero m₁)

name: DG.δ_comp_zero_cocycle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_zero_cocycle {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n) (z₂ : Cocycle A N P 0) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((z₂ : Cochain A N P 0).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (z₂ : Cochain A N P 0).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)

name: DG.δ_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_neg (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (-z) = -δ n m z

name: DG.δ_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_ofHom {p : ℤ} (φ : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : δ 0 p (Cochain.ofHom φ) = 0

name: DG.δ_ofHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_ofHom_comp {n : ℤ} (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (z : Cochain A N P n) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m (z.comp (Cochain.ofHom f) (zero_add n)) =
      (δ n m z).comp (Cochain.ofHom f) (zero_add m)

name: DG.δ_shape
statement: theorem δ_shape (hnm : ¬ n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m z = 0

name: DG.δ_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_sub (z₁ z₂ : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (z₁ - z₂) = δ n m z₁ - δ n m z₂

name: DG.δ_units_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (u • z) = u • δ n m z

name: DG.δ_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_zero : δ n m (0 : Cochain A M N n) = 0

name: DG.δ_zero_cochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cochain_apply (z : Cochain A M N 0) (x : M) :
    δ 0 1 z x = d (z x) - z (d x)

name: DG.δ_zero_cochain_comp
statement:
theorem δ_zero_cochain_comp {n₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (m₂ : ℤ) (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₂ m₂ (z₂.comp z₁ (zero_add n₂)) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (zero_add m₂) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ 0 1 z₁) (by rw [add_comm, h₂])

name: DG.δ_zero_cocycle_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cocycle_comp {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cocycle A M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m (z₂.comp (z₁ : Cochain A M N 0) (zero_add n)) =
      (δ n m z₂).comp (z₁ : Cochain A M N 0) (zero_add m)

name: DG.δ_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_zsmul (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (k • z) = k • δ n m z

name: DG.δ_δ
statement: theorem δ_δ (n₀ n₁ n₂ : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n₀) : δ n₁ n₂ (δ n₀ n₁ z) = 0

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.add_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem add_app (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) (X : C) :

statement:
theorem add_apply (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.add_comp
statement:

protected theorem add_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ z₂' : Cochain N P n₂)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.app_injective
statement: theorem app_injective : Function.Injective (app : Cochain M N n → ∀ X, M.obj X →+ N.obj X)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_add
statement:

protected theorem comp_add {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ z₁' : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (z₁ + z₁') h = z₂.comp z₁ h + z₂.comp z₁' h

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (z₂.comp z₁ h).app X x = z₂.app X (z₁.app X x)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {n₁ n₂ n₃ n₁₂ n₂₃ n₁₂₃ : ℤ}
    (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (z₃ : Cochain P Q n₃)
    (h₁₂ : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (h₂₃ : n₂ + n₃ = n₂₃) (h₁₂₃ : n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃) :
    z₃.comp (z₂.comp z₁ h₁₂) (show n₁₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃ by rw [← h₁₂, h₁₂₃]) =
      (z₃.comp z₂ h₂₃).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₂₃, ← h₁₂₃, add_assoc])

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_id
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_id {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n) :
    z.comp (Cochain.id M) (zero_add n) = z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_neg
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_neg {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (-z₁) h = -z₂.comp z₁ h

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_sub
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_sub {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ z₁' : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (z₁ - z₁') h = z₂.comp z₁ h - z₂.comp z₁' h

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_units_smul {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (u : ℤˣ) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (u • z₁) h = u • z₂.comp z₁ h

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_zero {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) :

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_zsmul

statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n} (h : ∀ X x, z₁.app X x = z₂.app X x) : z₁ = z₂

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.heq_of_forall

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.id_apply
statement:

theorem id_apply {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (Cochain.id M).app X x = x

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.id_comp

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} {i : ℤ} {x : M.obj X} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (z : Cochain M N n) {X Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (x : M.obj X) : z.app Y (f • x) = koszulSign (n * i) • (f • z.app X x)

theorem map_units_smul (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (u : ℤˣ) (x : M.obj X) :

statement:

theorem ofHom_apply (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (ofHom φ).app X x = φ.app X x

theorem ofHom_comp (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P) :

theorem ofHoms_apply (φ : ∀ X, M.obj X →+ N.obj X)

    (hs : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : M.obj X), φ Y (f • x) = f • φ X x) {X : C}

statement:
theorem mem_iff {n : ℤ} (m : ℤ) (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) :

theorem δ_eq_zero {n : ℤ} (z : Cocycle M N n) (m : ℤ) : δ n m (z : Cochain M N n) = 0

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.dHom_of
statement:
theorem dHom_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    dHom M N (DirectSum.of _ n z) = DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (δ n (n + 1) z)

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_of
statement:
theorem d_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n z : HOM M N) =

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.grading_eq
statement:
theorem grading_eq (n : ℤ) :
    grading (M := HOM M N) n = summand (fun n => Cochain M N n) n

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.of_congr
DG.CatModule.HOM.of_units_smul
statement:
theorem of_units_smul (i : ℤ) (u : ℤˣ) (f : Cochain M N i) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) i (u • f) : HOM M N) =
      u • DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) i f

name: DG.CatModule.δ_add
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_add (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (z₁ + z₂) = δ n m z₁ + δ n m z₂

name: DG.CatModule.δ_apply
statement:
theorem δ_apply (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (δ n m z).app X x = d (z.app X x) - koszulSign n • z.app X (d x)

name: DG.CatModule.δ_apply'
statement:
theorem δ_apply' (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (δ n m z).app X x = d (z.app X x) + koszulSign m • z.app X (d x)

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp
statement:
theorem δ_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (m₁ m₂ m₁₂ : ℤ) (h₁₂ : n₁₂ + 1 = m₁₂) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁)
    (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₁₂ m₁₂ (z₂.comp z₁ h) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₂, ← h, add_assoc]) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁)
          (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₁, ← h, add_assoc, add_comm 1, add_assoc])

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_ofHom {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n) (f : N ⟶ P) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((Cochain.ofHom f).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (Cochain.ofHom f).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp_zero_cochain
statement:
theorem δ_comp_zero_cochain {n₁ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P 0)
    (m₁ : ℤ) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁) :
    δ n₁ m₁ (z₂.comp z₁ (add_zero n₁)) =
      (δ 0 1 z₂).comp z₁ h₁ + z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁) (add_zero m₁)

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp_zero_cocycle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_zero_cocycle {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n) (z₂ : Cocycle N P 0) (m : ℤ) :

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zero_cochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cochain_apply (z : Cochain M N 0) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zero_cochain_comp
statement:
theorem δ_zero_cochain_comp {n₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (m₂ : ℤ) (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₂ m₂ (z₂.comp z₁ (zero_add n₂)) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (zero_add m₂) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ 0 1 z₁) (by rw [add_comm, h₂])

      (δ n m z₂).comp (z₁ : Cochain M N 0) (zero_add m)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_smul
statement: theorem Cochain.ofHom_smul (r : R) (φ : M ⟶ N) : Cochain.ofHom (r • φ) = r • Cochain.ofHom φ

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.smul_comp
statement:
theorem smul_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (r • z₂).comp z₁ h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.smul_ground_app
statement:
theorem smul_ground_app (r : R) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (r • z).app X x = (r • 𝟙 X) • z.app X x

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_smul_ground
statement: theorem d_smul_ground (r : R) (F : HOM M N) : d (r • F) = r • d F

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.smul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem smul_mem_grading (r : R) {n : ℤ} {F : HOM M N} (hF : F ∈ grading n) :
    r • F ∈ grading n

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of (r : R) (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n z : HOM M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n (r • z)

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.smul
statement: theorem Homotopic.smul {f g : M ⟶ N} (r : R) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (r • f) (r • g)

name: DG.CatModule.add_smul_id_smul
statement:
theorem add_smul_id_smul {X : C} (r s : R) (m : M.obj X) :
    ((r + s) • 𝟙 X) • m = (r • 𝟙 X) • m + (s • 𝟙 X) • m

name: DG.CatModule.d_smul_id_smul
statement: theorem d_smul_id_smul {X : C} (r : R) (m : M.obj X) : d ((r • 𝟙 X) • m) = (r • 𝟙 X) • d m

name: DG.CatModule.mul_smul_id_smul
statement:
theorem mul_smul_id_smul {X : C} (r s : R) (m : M.obj X) :
    ((r * s) • 𝟙 X) • m = (r • 𝟙 X) • (s • 𝟙 X) • m

name: DG.CatModule.one_smul_id_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_smul_id_smul {X : C} (m : M.obj X) : ((1 : R) • 𝟙 X) • m = m

name: DG.CatModule.smul_app
statement:
theorem smul_app (r : R) (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (m : M.obj X) :
    (r • φ).app X m = (r • 𝟙 X) • φ.app X m

name: DG.CatModule.smul_id_smul_comm
statement:
theorem smul_id_smul_comm {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (r • 𝟙 Y) • f • m = f • (r • 𝟙 X) • m

name: DG.CatModule.smul_id_smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_id_smul_mem {X : C} (r : R) {i : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading i) :
    (r • 𝟙 X) • m ∈ grading i

name: DG.CatModule.smul_smul_id
statement:
theorem smul_smul_id {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (r • f) • m = (r • 𝟙 Y) • f • m

name: DG.CatModule.zero_smul_id_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_smul_id_smul {X : C} (m : M.obj X) : ((0 : R) • 𝟙 X) • m = 0

name: DG.CatModule.δ_smul_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_smul_ground (n m : ℤ) (r : R) (z : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (r • z) = r • δ n m z

name: DG.CatModule.coe_yonedaEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_yonedaEquiv_apply (φ : representable X ⟶ M) :
    (yonedaEquiv φ : M.obj X) = φ.app X (𝟙 X)

name: DG.CatModule.representable_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representable_obj (X Y : C) : (representable X).obj Y = (X ⟶ Y)

name: DG.CatModule.representable_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representable_smul {X Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (h : (representable X).obj Y) :
    f • h = (h : X ⟶ Y) ≫ f

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem yonedaEquiv_comp {N : CatModule.{v} C} (φ : representable X ⟶ M) (ψ : M ⟶ N) :
    (yonedaEquiv (φ ≫ ψ) : N.obj X) = ψ.app X (yonedaEquiv φ)

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply (m : cocycles (M.obj X) 0) {Y : C} (h : X ⟶ Y) :
    (yonedaEquiv.symm m).app Y h = h • (m : M.obj X)

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaEquiv_symm_comp
statement:
theorem yonedaEquiv_symm_comp {N : CatModule.{v} C} (m : cocycles (M.obj X) 0) (ψ : M ⟶ N) :
    yonedaEquiv.symm m ≫ ψ =
      yonedaEquiv.symm ⟨ψ.app X m, ψ.map_mem m.2.1,
        show d (ψ.app X m) = 0 by rw [← ψ.map_d, m.2.2, map_zero]⟩

name: DG.CatModule.yoneda_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yoneda_map_app {X X' : (DGCategory.Z0 C)ᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ X') {Y : C}
    (h : (representable X.unop.as).obj Y) :
    ((yoneda C).map f).app Y h = f.unop.hom ≫ (h : X.unop.as ⟶ Y)

name: DG.DGRightModule.actHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem actHom_apply (a : A) (m : M) : actHom A M a m = MulOpposite.op a • m

name: DG.koszulTwist_apply_of_mem
DG.koszulTwist_koszulTwist
statement:
@[simp]
theorem koszulTwist_koszulTwist (f : A →+ M →+ N) : koszulTwist (koszulTwist f) = f

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochainApp_comp
DG.CatModule.yonedaCochainApp_of_mem
DG.CatModule.yonedaCochain_app_id
statement:
theorem yonedaCochain_app_id (n : ℤ) (m : grading (M := M.obj X) n) :
    (yonedaCochain n m).app X (𝟙 X) = m

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochain_app_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yonedaCochain_app_of_mem (n : ℤ) (m : grading (M := M.obj X) n) {Y : C} {i : ℤ}
    {h : X ⟶ Y} (hh : h ∈ grading i) :
    (yonedaCochain n m).app Y h = koszulSign (i * n) • (h • (m : M.obj X))

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochain_eval
statement:
theorem yonedaCochain_eval {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain (representable X) M n) :
    yonedaCochain n ⟨z.app X (𝟙 X), by simpa using z.map_mem (id_mem_grading X)⟩ = z

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yonedaHOM_of {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain (representable X) M n) :
    yonedaHOM X M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) M n) n z) = z.app X (𝟙 X)

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_ofHom
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_ofHom (φ : representable X ⟶ M) :
    yonedaHOM X M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) M n) 0 (Cochain.ofHom φ)) =
      (yonedaEquiv φ : M.obj X)

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_symm_of_mem
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_symm_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    (yonedaHOM X M).symm m =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) M n) n (yonedaCochain n ⟨m, hm⟩)

name: DG.ULift.d_down
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ULift.d_down (a : ULift.{w'} A) : (d a).down = d a.down

name: DG.ULift.d_up
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ULift.d_up (a : A) : d (ULift.up.{w'} a) = ULift.up (d a)

name: DG.ULift.downHom_comp_upHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ULift.downHom_comp_upHom :
    (ULift.downHom.{w'} M).comp (ULift.upHom.{w'} M) = (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)

name: DG.ULift.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem ULift.mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : ULift.{w'} A} : a ∈ grading n ↔ a.down ∈ grading n

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.app_eq
statement:
theorem app_eq {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) :
    z.app Y r = twist n (hg.coord Y r) • z.app X g

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.app_gen_mem
statement: theorem app_gen_mem {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) : z.app X g ∈ grading (k + n)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.app_smul_gen
statement:
theorem app_smul_gen {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    z.app Y (f • g) = twist n f • z.app X g

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_act
statement:
theorem coord_act {Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (r : R.obj Y) :
    hg.coord Z (f • r) = hg.coord Y r ≫ f

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_apply
statement:
theorem coord_apply {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) :
    hg.coord Y r = e.val ≫ Function.surjInv (hg.surjective Y) r

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_d
statement: theorem coord_d {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) : hg.coord Y (d r) = d (hg.coord Y r)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_eq
statement:
theorem coord_eq {Y : C} {r : R.obj Y} {f : X ⟶ Y} (h : f • g = r) :
    hg.coord Y r = e.val ≫ f

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coord_gen : hg.coord X g = e.val

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_mem
statement:
theorem coord_mem {Y : C} {i : ℤ} {r : R.obj Y} (hr : r ∈ grading i) :
    hg.coord Y r ∈ grading (i - k)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coord_smul {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) : hg.coord Y r • g = r

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_smul_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coord_smul_gen {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : hg.coord Y (f • g) = e.val ≫ f

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.eq_ofElement
statement: theorem eq_ofElement {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) : z = hg.ofElement _ (hg.app_gen_mem z)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ext_gen
statement: theorem ext_gen {n : ℤ} {z z' : Cochain R N n} (h : z.app X g = z'.app X g) : z = z'

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_add
statement:
theorem ofElement_add {n : ℤ} (y y' : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n))
    (hy' : y' ∈ grading (k + n)) :
    hg.ofElement (y + y') (add_mem hy hy') = hg.ofElement y hy + hg.ofElement y' hy'

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_apply
statement:
theorem ofElement_apply {n : ℤ} (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n)) {Y : C}
    (r : R.obj Y) : (hg.ofElement y hy).app Y r = twist n (hg.coord Y r) • y

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_congr
statement:
theorem ofElement_congr {n : ℤ} {y y' : N.obj X} (h : y = y') (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n))
    (hy' : y' ∈ grading (k + n)) : hg.ofElement y hy = hg.ofElement y' hy'

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofElement_gen {n : ℤ} (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n)) :
    (hg.ofElement y hy).app X g = e.val • y

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_smul_gen
DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofElement_zero {n : ℤ} : hg.ofElement (0 : N.obj X) (zero_mem (grading (k + n))) = 0

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofHom_eq_ofElement
statement:
theorem ofHom_eq_ofElement (φ : R ⟶ N) :
    Cochain.ofHom φ = hg.ofElement (φ.app X g) (by simpa using φ.map_mem hg.mem_grading)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.of_bijective
statement:
theorem of_bijective [DGCategory C] (hk : g ∈ grading k) (hd : d g = 0)
    (hb : ∀ Y : C, Function.Bijective fun f : X ⟶ Y => f • g) :
    IsCornerGenerator R (DGCategory.Idempotent.id X) k g

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.twist_twist_self
statement: theorem twist_twist_self (n : ℤ) {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist n (twist n f) = f

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_comp_coord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem val_comp_coord {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) : e.val ≫ hg.coord Y r = hg.coord Y r

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_comp_eq
statement: theorem val_comp_eq {Y : C} {f f' : X ⟶ Y} (h : f • g = f' • g) : e.val ≫ f = e.val ≫ f'

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_comp_smul
statement: theorem val_comp_smul {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (e.val ≫ f) • g = f • g

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_smul_app_gen
statement: theorem val_smul_app_gen {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) : e.val • z.app X g = z.app X g

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.δ_ofElement
statement:
theorem δ_ofElement {n m : ℤ} (hnm : n + 1 = m) (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n))
    (hdy : d y ∈ grading (k + m)) : δ n m (hg.ofElement y hy) = hg.ofElement (d y) hdy

name: DG.CatModule.mem_cornerSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cornerSubmodule_iff {Y : C} {h : X ⟶ Y} :
    h ∈ (cornerSubmodule e).carrier Y ↔ e.val ≫ h = h

name: DG.CatModule.ulift_smul_down
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ulift_smul_down {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : (ulift.{w'} M).obj X) :
    (f • m : (ulift.{w'} M).obj Y).down = f • m.down

name: DG.CatModule.ulift_smul_up
statement:
theorem ulift_smul_up {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    f • (show (ulift.{w'} M).obj X from ULift.up m) =
      (show (ulift.{w'} M).obj Y from ULift.up (f • m))

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.comp_self_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_self_assoc {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : e.val ≫ e.val ≫ f = e.val ≫ f

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.d_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_val : d e.val = 0

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.mem_grading
statement: theorem mem_grading : e.val ∈ grading (M := X ⟶ X) 0

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.twist_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_val (n : ℤ) : CatModule.twist n e.val = e.val

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.IsSimple.exists_inv
statement:
theorem IsSimple.exists_inv {Y : C} {e : Idempotent X} {f : Idempotent Y} (he : e.IsSimple)
    (hf : f.IsSimple) {b : Y ⟶ X} (hb : b ∈ grading 0) (hfb : f.val ≫ b = b)
    (hbe : b ≫ e.val = b) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : X ⟶ Y, c ∈ grading 0 ∧ e.val ≫ c = c ∧ c ≫ f.val = c ∧ b ≫ c = f.val ∧
      c ≫ b = e.val

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.Orthogonal.symm
statement: theorem Orthogonal.symm {e f : Idempotent X} (h : e.Orthogonal f) : f.Orthogonal e

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.listSum_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem listSum_val (l : List (Idempotent X)) (hl : l.Pairwise Orthogonal) :
    (listSum l hl).val = (l.map Idempotent.val).sum

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.orthogonal_listSum
DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.descCochain_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descCochain_of {k : ℤ} (c : ∀ n, Cochain (S n) N k)
    (hc : ∀ n {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X), (c (n + 1)).app X ((ι n).app X x) = (c n).app X x)
    (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (descCochain c hc).app X ((of S ι n).app X x) = (c n).app X x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.desc_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem desc_of (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (desc g hg).app X ((of S ι n).app X x) = (g n).app X x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.exists_of_eq
statement:
theorem exists_of_eq {X : C} (x : (seqColimit S ι).obj X) :
    ∃ n y, (of S ι n).app X y = x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_app
statement:
theorem of_app (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (of S ι n).app X x =
      (Hom.range (relHom S ι)).mkQ.app X (DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x)

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_comp_desc
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem of_comp_desc (n : ℕ) : of S ι n ≫ desc g hg = g n

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_injective
statement:
theorem of_injective (hι : ∀ n X, Function.Injective ((ι n).app X)) (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    Function.Injective ((of S ι n).app X)

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_succ_ι
statement:
theorem of_succ_ι (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (of S ι (n + 1)).app X ((ι n).app X x) = (of S ι n).app X x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.relHom_apply_succ
statement:
theorem relHom_apply_succ {X : C} y (k : ℕ) :
    relHomApp S ι X y (k + 1) = y (k + 1) - (ι k).app X (y k)

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.relHom_apply_zero
statement: theorem relHom_apply_zero {X : C} y : relHomApp S ι X y 0 = y 0

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.relHom_of
statement:
theorem relHom_of {X : C} (n : ℕ) (x : (S n).obj X) :
    relHomApp S ι X (DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x -
        DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) (n + 1) ((ι n).app X x)

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.ι_comp_of
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem ι_comp_of (n : ℕ) : ι n ≫ of S ι (n + 1) = of S ι n

name: DG.CatSubmodule.liftQCochain_app_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftQCochain_app_mkQ {n : ℤ} (c : CatModule.Cochain M N n)
    (h : ∀ X, ∀ m ∈ S.carrier X, c.app X m = 0) {X : C} (m : M.obj X) :
    (S.liftQCochain c h).app X (S.mkQ.app X m) = c.app X m

name: DG.InternalGrading.coe_d_wgrading
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d_wgrading {k : ℤ} (m : wgrading (M := M) k) : ((d m : wgrading k) : M) = d (m : M)

name: DG.InternalGrading.coe_decompose_wgrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_wgrading {k : ℤ} (m : wgrading (M := M) k) (n : ℤ) :
    ((decompose (grading (M := wgrading (M := M) k)) m n : wgrading (M := M) k) : M) =
      decompose (grading (M := M)) (m : M) n

name: DG.InternalGrading.mem_grading_wgrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_wgrading_iff {k n : ℤ} {m : wgrading (M := M) k} :
    m ∈ grading n ↔ (m : M) ∈ grading n

name: DG.WeightCategory.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_val {k l m : WeightCategory A} (f : k ⟶ l) (g : l ⟶ m) :
    (f ≫ g).1 = g.1 * f.1

name: DG.WeightCategory.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {k l : WeightCategory A} {f g : k ⟶ l} (h : f.1 = g.1) : f = g

name: DG.WeightCategory.id_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id_val (k : WeightCategory A) : (𝟙 k : k ⟶ k).1 = 1

name: DG.WeightCategory.mem_wgrading
statement: theorem mem_wgrading {k l : WeightCategory A} (f : k ⟶ l) : f.1 ∈ wgrading (M := A) (l.as - k.as)

name: DG.WeightCategory.shiftEquiv_functor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftEquiv_functor (s : ℤ) : (shiftEquiv A s).functor = shiftFunctor A s

name: DG.WeightCategory.shiftEquiv_inverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftEquiv_inverse (s : ℤ) : (shiftEquiv A s).inverse = shiftFunctor A (-s)

name: DG.WeightCategory.shiftFunctor_map_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftFunctor_map_val (s : ℤ) {k l : WeightCategory A} (f : k ⟶ l) :
    ((shiftFunctor A s).map f).1 = f.1

name: DG.WeightCategory.homOfMem_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOfMem_val {j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ wgrading (M := A) j) (k l : ℤ) (h : l - k = j) :
    (homOfMem ha k l h).1 = a

name: DG.coe_decompose_range
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_range [Decomposition fun i => (f i).range]

    (decompose (fun i => (f i).range) (DirectSum.toAddMonoid f w) i : T) = f i (w i)

name: DG.isInternal_range_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isInternal_range_of_bijective

name: DG.AbelianK0.sum_range_negOnePow_telescope
statement:
theorem sum_range_negOnePow_telescope (x h c : ℤ → G) (hx : ∀ n, x n = h n + c (n - 1) + c n)
    (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a + i).negOnePow • x (a + i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a + i).negOnePow • h (a + i) + a.negOnePow • c (a - 1) -
        (a + m).negOnePow • c (a + m - 1)

    (ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.subtype (LinearMap.ker (C.d n (n + 1)).hom)))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.ker (C.d (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1)).hom)
      (C.d n (n + 1)).hom fun x => LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (d_apply_d_apply _ _ _ x))) (by
        ext x
        simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom,
          ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype]
        exact (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp x.2))).ShortExact

DG.freeDeriv_mul

theorem freeDeriv_mul (a b : FreeAlgebra R X) :

name: DG.freeDeriv_mul_of_mem

theorem freeDeriv_mul_of_mem {n : ℤ} {a : FreeAlgebra R X} (ha : a ∈ freeGrading R deg n)

name: DG.freeGrading.decomposeAlgHom_prod
statement:
theorem decomposeAlgHom_prod (l : List X) :
    decomposeAlgHom R deg (l.map (FreeAlgebra.ι R)).prod =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => freeGrading R deg n) (l.map deg).sum
        ⟨_, prod_mem_freeGrading l⟩

name: DG.freeGrading.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem freeGrading.induction_on {n : ℤ}
    {P : ∀ a : FreeAlgebra R X, a ∈ freeGrading R deg n → Prop}
    (h_prod : ∀ (l : List X) (hl : (l.map deg).sum = n),
      P (l.map (FreeAlgebra.ι R)).prod (hl ▸ prod_mem_freeGrading l))
    (h_zero : P 0 (zero_mem _))
    (h_add : ∀ a b ha hb, P a ha → P b hb → P (a + b) (add_mem ha hb))
    (h_smul : ∀ (r : R) a ha, P a ha → P (r • a) (Submodule.smul_mem _ r ha))
    {a : FreeAlgebra R X} (ha : a ∈ freeGrading R deg n) : P a ha

name: DG.DGModuleCat.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem cohomologyAddEquiv_mk (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    cohomologyAddEquiv R M n (cohomology.mk M n z) =
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat R) Ab).map (((forget R A).obj M).homologyπ n)
        (((forget R A).obj M).cyclesMk
          (⟨z, cocycles.mem_grading z⟩ : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A M n) (n + 1)
          (CochainComplex.next ℤ n)
          (Subtype.ext ((toComplex_d_apply R M rfl _).trans (cocycles.d_eq_zero z))))

name: DG.DGModuleCat.δ_forget_apply
statement:

    (h₂ : S.g x₂ = z₃) (x₁ : S.X₁) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ grading (n + 1)) (h₁ : S.f x₁ = d x₂) :
    (shortExact_map_forget R hS).δ n (n + 1) rfl
        (cohomologyAddEquiv R S.X₃ n (cohomology.mk _ n z₃)) =
      cohomologyAddEquiv R S.X₁ (n + 1) (cohomology.mk _ (n + 1)

name: DG.Homotopic.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic g f

name: DG.Homotopic.trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem trans (h₁ : Homotopic e f) (h₂ : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic e g

name: DG.Homotopic.zsmul
statement: theorem zsmul (k : ℤ) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (k • f) (k • g)

name: DG.IsContractible.cohomology_eq_zero
statement: theorem cohomology_eq_zero (hM : IsContractible A M) {n : ℤ} (x : cohomology M n) : x = 0

name: DG.comp_mem_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem comp_mem_nullHomotopic {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic A M N)
    (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) : g.comp f ∈ nullHomotopic A M P

name: DG.homotopic_equivalence
statement: theorem homotopic_equivalence : Equivalence (Homotopic : (M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) → (M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) → Prop)

name: DG.homotopic_iff_sub_mem
statement:
theorem homotopic_iff_sub_mem {f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} :
    Homotopic f g ↔ f - g ∈ nullHomotopic A M N

name: DG.mem_nullHomotopic_comp
statement:
theorem mem_nullHomotopic_comp {f : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic A N P)
    (e : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : f.comp e ∈ nullHomotopic A M P

name: DG.mem_nullHomotopic_iff
statement: theorem mem_nullHomotopic_iff {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} : f ∈ nullHomotopic A M N ↔ Homotopic f 0

name: DG.mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} :
    f ∈ nullHomotopic A M N ↔ ∃ h : Cochain A M N (-1), ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h

name: DG.nullHomotopicMap_mem
statement:
theorem nullHomotopicMap_mem (h : Cochain A M N (-1)) :
    DGHomotopy.nullHomotopicMap h ∈ nullHomotopic A M N

name: DG.quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv A M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (Cocycle.ofHom f)

name: DG.δ_neg_one_apply
statement:
theorem δ_neg_one_apply (z : Cochain A M N (-1)) (x : M) :
    δ (-1) 0 z x = d (z x) + z (d x)

name: DG.Homotopic.smul
statement: theorem Homotopic.smul (r : R) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (r • f) (r • g)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.eq_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem eq_of_homotopy {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f g : M ⟶ N) (h : DGHomotopy f.hom g.hom) :
    (quotient A).map f = (quotient A).map g

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map (f : M ⟶ N) :
    homAddEquivQuotient M N ((quotient A).map f) = QuotientAddGroup.mk f.hom

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.isZero_quotient_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_quotient_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    IsZero ((quotient A).obj M) ↔ IsContractible A M

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_bijective
statement:
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (quotientNullHomotopicAddHom M N)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddHom M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      (quotient A).map (DGModuleCat.ofHom f)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_map_eq_iff {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f g : M ⟶ N) :
    (quotient A).map f = (quotient A).map g ↔ Homotopic f.hom g.hom

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_out
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotient_map_out {M N : HomotopyCategory.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (quotient A).map (Quot.out f) = f

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective
statement:
theorem quotient_obj_surjective (X : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    ∃ M : DGModuleCat.{v} A, (quotient A).obj M = X

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyAddEquiv_mk (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    e.cohomologyAddEquiv n (cohomology.mk M n z) =
      cohomology.mk N n ⟨e z, e.map_mem z.2.1,
        show d (e (z : M)) = 0 by rw [← map_d, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, map_zero]⟩

name: DG.DGModuleCat.coproductCocone_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coproductCocone_inj (j : J) :
    (coproductCocone F).inj j = ofHom (DGModuleHom.lof A (fun j => (F j : Type (max v w))) j)

name: DG.DGModuleCat.coproductCocone_pt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coproductCocone_pt : (coproductCocone F).pt = of A (⨁ j : J, F j)

name: DG.DGModuleCat.descEval_fac
statement:
theorem descEval_fac {n : ℤ}
    (s : Cocone ((Discrete.functor F) ⋙ forget R A ⋙ HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ n)) (j : J) :
    ((forget R A ⋙ HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ n).mapCocone (coproductCocone F)).ι.app ⟨j⟩ ≫
      descEval s = s.ι.app ⟨j⟩

name: DG.DGModuleCat.descEval_uniq
statement:
theorem descEval_uniq {n : ℤ}
    (s : Cocone ((Discrete.functor F) ⋙ forget R A ⋙ HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ n))
    (m : ModuleCat.of R (DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (coproductCocone F).pt n) ⟶ s.pt)
    (hm : ∀ j, m.hom ∘ₗ homRestrict R ((coproductCocone F).inj j) n = (s.ι.app ⟨j⟩).hom) :
    m = descEval s

name: DG.DGModuleCat.gradingDirectSumEquiv_symm_homRestrict
statement:
theorem gradingDirectSumEquiv_symm_homRestrict (n : ℤ) (j : J)
    (x : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (F j) n) :
    (gradingDirectSumEquiv R F n).symm (homRestrict R ((coproductCocone F).inj j) n x) =
      DirectSum.lof R J (fun j => DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (F j) n) j x

name: DG.DGModuleCat.gradingDirectSum_bijective
statement: theorem gradingDirectSum_bijective (n : ℤ) : Function.Bijective (gradingDirectSum R F n)

name: DG.DGModuleCat.gradingDirectSum_lof
statement:
theorem gradingDirectSum_lof (n : ℤ) (j : J) (x : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (F j) n) :
    gradingDirectSum R F n (DirectSum.lof R J (fun j => DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (F j) n) j x)
      = homRestrict R ((coproductCocone F).inj j) n x

name: DG.DGModuleCat.toFamily_gradingDirectSum
statement:
theorem toFamily_gradingDirectSum (n : ℤ) (y : ⨁ j, DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (F j) n)
    (j : J) : toFamily R F (gradingDirectSum R F n y) j = (y j : F j)

name: DG.IsPerfect.K0ToProjK0_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem K0ToProjK0_mk [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    K0ToProjK0 P hP (K0.mk X) = eulerChar X.obj ((hP _).1 X.property)

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_eq
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsPerfect R X)
    {K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ} (hK : IsPerfectComplex K)
    (e : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ X) : eulerChar X hX = hK.eulerChar

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso {X Y : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hX : IsPerfect R X) (hY : IsPerfect R Y) : eulerChar X hX = eulerChar Y hY

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_obj₂
statement:
theorem eulerChar_obj₂ (T : Triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)))
    (hT : T ∈ distTriang _) (h₁ : IsPerfect R T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsPerfect R T.obj₂)
    (h₃ : IsPerfect R T.obj₃) :
    eulerChar T.obj₂ h₂ = eulerChar T.obj₁ h₁ + eulerChar T.obj₃ h₃

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_singleFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem eulerChar_singleFunctor_obj {M : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hM : IsFGProjective R M) (n : ℤ)
    (h : IsPerfect R ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) n).obj M)) :
    eulerChar _ h = n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk M hM

name: DG.piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp_hom_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp_hom_π (n : ℤ) (X : C) (j : J) :
    (piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp Φ n X).hom ≫ (Pi.π _ j)⟦n⟧' =
      Pi.π _ j ≫ ((Φ j).commShiftIso n).hom.app X

name: DG.piFunctor_map_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem piFunctor_map_π {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : J) :
    (piFunctor Φ).map f ≫ Pi.π _ j = Pi.π _ j ≫ (Φ j).map f

name: DG.shift_pi_hom_ext
statement:
theorem shift_pi_hom_ext (n : ℤ) {f : J → D} {Y : D} {g g' : Y ⟶ (∏ᶜ f)⟦n⟧}
    (h : ∀ j, g ≫ (Pi.π f j)⟦n⟧' = g' ≫ (Pi.π f j)⟦n⟧') : g = g'

name: DG.K0Rel.addMonoidHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addMonoidHom_ext {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] ⦃f g : K0Rel C r →+ G⦄
    (h : ∀ X : C, f (mk X) = g (mk X)) : f = g

name: DG.K0Rel.equivQuotient_mk
statement:
theorem equivQuotient_mk (X : C) :
    equivQuotient P hr hP (mk X) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (K0.mk X)

name: DG.K0Rel.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (f : C → G) (hf) (hr) (X : C) :
    lift (r := r) f hf hr (mk X) = f X

name: DG.K0Rel.mkHom_surjective
statement: theorem mkHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkHom C r)

name: DG.K0Rel.mk_eq_of_rel
statement: theorem mk_eq_of_rel {X Y : C} (h : r X Y) : (mk X : K0Rel C r) = mk Y

name: DG.K0Rel.mk_obj₂
statement:
theorem mk_obj₂ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    (mk T.obj₂ : K0Rel C r) = mk T.obj₁ + mk T.obj₃

name: DG.K0Rel.of_sub_of_mem_relations_of_iso
statement:
theorem of_sub_of_mem_relations_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    FreeAbelianGroup.of X - FreeAbelianGroup.of Y ∈ K0.relations C

name: DG.K0Rel.relations_eq
statement:
theorem relations_eq : relations C r = K0.relations C ⊔
    AddSubgroup.closure {x | ∃ X, x = FreeAbelianGroup.of (P X) - FreeAbelianGroup.of X}

name: DG.Cochain.signedApplyHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedApplyHom_apply {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    signedApplyHom A M N n z = z.signedApply

name: DG.Cochain.signedApply_of_mem
statement:
theorem signedApply_of_mem {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A M N n) {i : ℤ} {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) : z.signedApply x = koszulSign (n * i) • z x

name: DG.DGModule.END.d_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem d_of_mul_of {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M) =
      d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f : END A M) * DirectSum.of _ n g +
        koszulSign m • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f *
          d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n g : END A M))

name: DG.DGModule.END.gMul_apply
statement:
theorem gMul_apply {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) (x : M) :
    (GradedMonoid.GMul.mul f g : Cochain A M M (m + n)) x = koszulSign (m * n) • g (f x)

name: DG.DGModule.END.gMul_def
statement:
theorem gMul_def {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    (GradedMonoid.GMul.mul f g : Cochain A M M (m + n)) = koszulSign (m * n) • g.comp f rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.gOne_def
statement: theorem gOne_def : (GradedMonoid.GOne.one : Cochain A M M 0) = Cochain.id A M

name: DG.DGModule.END.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_of {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M) =
      DirectSum.of _ (m + n) (koszulSign (m * n) • g.comp f rfl)

name: DG.DGModule.END.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : END A M) = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (Cochain.id A M)

name: DG.DGModule.END.rightAction_apply
statement:
theorem rightAction_apply (F : END A M) (x : M) :
    (rightAction A M F).unop x = signedEval A M F x

name: DG.DGModule.END.rightAction_of_apply
statement:
theorem rightAction_of_apply {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M n) {i : ℤ} {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    (rightAction A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n f)).unop x =
      koszulSign (n * i) • f x

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_mul
statement:
theorem signedEval_mul (F G : END A M) :
    signedEval A M (F * G) = (signedEval A M G).comp (signedEval A M F)

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedEval_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M n) :
    signedEval A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n f) = f.signedApply

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem signedEval_of_mul_of {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    signedEval A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M) =
      g.signedApply.comp f.signedApply

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedEval_one : signedEval A M 1 = AddMonoidHom.id M

name: DG.Cochain.coe_smul_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_smul_ground (r : R) (f : Cochain A M N n) : ⇑(r • f) = r • ⇑f

name: DG.Cochain.comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_smul {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (r • z₁) h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h

name: DG.Cochain.map_smul_ground
statement: theorem map_smul_ground (f : Cochain A M N n) (r : R) (x : M) : f (r • x) = r • f x

name: DG.Cochain.smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (r • z₂).comp z₁ h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h

name: DG.Cochain.smul_ground_apply
statement: theorem smul_ground_apply (r : R) (f : Cochain A M N n) (x : M) : (r • f) x = r • f x

name: DG.DGModule.END.algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (END A M) r = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (r • Cochain.id A M)

name: DG.DGModule.END.mul_smul_comm_ground
statement: theorem mul_smul_comm_ground (r : R) (F G : END A M) : F * (r • G) = r • (F * G)

name: DG.DGModule.END.of_mul_smul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_smul_of (r : R) {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * (r • DirectSum.of _ n g) =
      r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M)

name: DG.DGModule.END.of_zero_smul_id
statement:
theorem of_zero_smul_id (r : R) :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (r • Cochain.id A M) = r • (1 : END A M)

name: DG.DGModule.END.smul_mul_assoc_ground
statement: theorem smul_mul_assoc_ground (r : R) (F G : END A M) : (r • F) * G = r • (F * G)

name: DG.DGModule.END.smul_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of_mul_of (r : R) {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    (r • DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f) * DirectSum.of _ n g =
      r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M)

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.d_smul_ground
statement: theorem d_smul_ground (r : R) (F : HOM A M N) : d (r • F) = r • d F

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of (r : R) (n : ℤ) (f : Cochain A M N n) :
    r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n f : HOM A M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n (r • f)

name: DG.δ_smul_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_smul_ground (n m : ℤ) (r : R) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (r • z) = r • δ n m z

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_apply
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_apply (a b : A) :
    DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b =
      a * b - b * a + (2 : R) • (DGAlgebra.oddPart R A b * DGAlgebra.oddPart R A a)

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_jacobi
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_jacobi {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) (c : A) :
    DGAlgebra.commutator R A a (DGAlgebra.commutator R A b c) =
      DGAlgebra.commutator R A (DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b) c +
        koszulSign (i * j) • DGAlgebra.commutator R A b (DGAlgebra.commutator R A a c)

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) : DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b ∈ grading (i + j)

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) :
    DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b = a * b - koszulSign (i * j) • (b * a)

name: DG.DGAlgebra.d_commutator
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.d_commutator {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (b : A) :
    d (DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b) =
      DGAlgebra.commutator R A (d a) b + koszulSign i • DGAlgebra.commutator R A a (d b)

name: DG.DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_even
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_even {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) :
    DGAlgebra.oddPart R A a = 0

name: DG.DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_odd
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_odd {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Odd i) :
    DGAlgebra.oddPart R A a = a

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.add_bracket
statement: theorem add_bracket (x x' y : L) : bracket R (x + x') y = bracket R x y + bracket R x' y

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_add
statement: theorem bracket_add (x y y' : L) : bracket R x (y + y') = bracket R x y + bracket R x y'

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_comm
statement:
theorem bracket_comm {i j : ℤ} {x y : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j) :
    bracket R x y = -(koszulSign (i * j) • bracket R y x)

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_mem
statement:
theorem bracket_mem {i j : ℤ} {x y : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j) :
    bracket R x y ∈ grading (i + j)

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_neg (x y : L) : bracket R x (-y) = -bracket R x y

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_self_of_even
statement:
theorem bracket_self_of_even {i : ℤ} {x : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) :
    bracket R x x = -bracket R x x

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_smul
statement: theorem bracket_smul (r : R) (x y : L) : bracket R x (r • y) = r • bracket R x y

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_units_smul
statement: theorem bracket_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (x y : L) : bracket R x (u • y) = u • bracket R x y

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_zero (x : L) : bracket R x 0 = 0

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracketₗ_apply
statement: theorem bracketₗ_apply (x y : L) : bracketₗ (R := R) x y = bracket R x y

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.d_bracket
statement:
theorem d_bracket {i : ℤ} {x : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (y : L) :
    d (bracket R x y) = bracket R (d x) y + koszulSign i • bracket R x (d y)

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.d_smul
statement: theorem d_smul (r : R) (x : L) : d (r • x) = r • d x

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi {i j : ℤ} {x y : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j) (z : L) :
    bracket R x (bracket R y z) =
      bracket R (bracket R x y) z + koszulSign (i * j) • bracket R y (bracket R x z)

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.jacobi_cyclic
statement:
theorem jacobi_cyclic {i j k : ℤ} {x y z : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j)
    (hz : z ∈ grading k) :
    koszulSign (i * k) • bracket R x (bracket R y z) +
      koszulSign (j * i) • bracket R y (bracket R z x) +
        koszulSign (k * j) • bracket R z (bracket R x y) = 0

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.ofDGAlgebra_bracket
statement:
theorem DGLieAlgebra.ofDGAlgebra_bracket (a b : A) :

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.smul_bracket

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.smul_mem
statement: theorem smul_mem (r : R) {n : ℤ} {x : L} (hx : x ∈ grading n) : r • x ∈ grading n

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.units_smul_bracket

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.ceDiff

theorem IsAlt.ceDiff {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) :

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.curry

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.curry_curry

theorem IsAlt.map_swap {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) (v : Fin n → 𝔤) {i j : Fin n}

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.sub

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceCoboundaries_le_ceCocycles
statement: theorem ceCoboundaries_le_ceCocycles (n : ℕ) : ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 n ≤ ceCocycles R 𝔤 n

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_apply
statement:
theorem ceD_apply {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) (v : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 n ω v = ceDiff R 𝔤 n ω.toMultilinearMap v

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem ceD_apply_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : Fin (n + 2) → 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 (n + 1) ω x = ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), ∑ i : Fin (n + 1),
      if (i : ℕ) < j then koszulSign (((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
        ω (Fin.cons ⁅x i.castSucc, x j⁆ (Fin.removeNth i (Fin.removeNth j x))) else 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_ceD
statement: theorem ceD_ceD {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) : ceD R 𝔤 (n + 1) (ceD R 𝔤 n ω) = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_cons
statement:
theorem ceD_cons {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x₀ : 𝔤) (y : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 (n + 1) ω (Fin.cons x₀ y) =
      -(∑ j : Fin (n + 1), koszulSign ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) • ω (Fin.cons ⁅x₀, y j⁆ (Fin.removeNth j y)))
        - ceD R 𝔤 n (ω.curryLeft x₀) y

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_one_apply
statement:
theorem ceD_one_apply (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 1) (x y : 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 1 ω ![x, y] = -ω ![⁅x, y⁆]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceD_zero (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 0) : ceD R 𝔤 0 ω = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff_ceDiff
statement: theorem ceDiff_ceDiff {n : ℕ} (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) : ceDiff R 𝔤 (n + 1) (ceDiff R 𝔤 n f) = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff_lieAct
statement:
theorem ceDiff_lieAct {n : ℕ} (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) :
    ceDiff R 𝔤 n (lieAct R 𝔤 n x f) = lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x (ceDiff R 𝔤 n f)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ceDiff_zero (f : MCochain R 𝔤 0) : ceDiff R 𝔤 0 f = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainOneEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cochainOneEquiv_apply (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 1) (x : 𝔤) :
    cochainOneEquiv R 𝔤 ω x = ω ![x]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainOneEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cochainOneEquiv_symm_apply (φ : Module.Dual R 𝔤) (v : Fin 1 → 𝔤) :
    (cochainOneEquiv R 𝔤).symm φ v = φ (v 0)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.comap_ceCoboundaries_one
statement:
theorem comap_ceCoboundaries_one :
    (ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 1).comap (ceCocycles R 𝔤 1).subtype = ⊥

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.comap_ceCoboundaries_zero
statement:
theorem comap_ceCoboundaries_zero :
    (ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 0).comap (ceCocycles R 𝔤 0).subtype = ⊥

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curryEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : 𝔤) (v : Fin n → 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x v = f (Fin.cons x v)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curryEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (φ : 𝔤 →ₗ[R] MCochain R 𝔤 n) (v : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n).symm φ v = φ (v 0) (Fin.tail v)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curryEquiv_toMultilinearMap
statement:
theorem curryEquiv_toMultilinearMap {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n ω.toMultilinearMap x = (ω.curryLeft x).toMultilinearMap

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curry_ceDiff
statement:
theorem curry_ceDiff {n : ℕ} (f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 (n + 1) (ceDiff R 𝔤 (n + 1) f) x =
      lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x f - ceDiff R 𝔤 n (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curry_lieAct
statement:
theorem curry_lieAct {n : ℕ} (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (y : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n (lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x f) y =
      lieAct R 𝔤 n x (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f y) - curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f ⁅x, y⁆

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ext_curry
statement:
theorem ext_curry {n : ℕ} {f g : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)}
    (h : ∀ x, curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x = curryEquiv R 𝔤 n g x) : f = g

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_curryEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem isAlt_curryEquiv_symm {n : ℕ} (φ : 𝔤 →ₗ[R] MCochain R 𝔤 n) (h₁ : ∀ x, IsAlt (φ x))
    (h₂ : ∀ (x : 𝔤) (w : Fin n → 𝔤) (k : Fin n), w k = x → φ x w = 0) :
    IsAlt ((curryEquiv R 𝔤 n).symm φ)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_toMultilinearMap
statement: theorem isAlt_toMultilinearMap {n : ℕ} (ω : 𝔤 [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] R) : IsAlt ω.toMultilinearMap

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_zero
statement: theorem isAlt_zero {n : ℕ} : IsAlt (0 : MCochain R 𝔤 n)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct_apply
statement:
theorem lieAct_apply {n : ℕ} (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) (v : Fin n → 𝔤) :
    lieAct R 𝔤 n x f v = -∑ j, f (Function.update v j ⁅x, v j⁆)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct_lie
statement:
theorem lieAct_lie {n : ℕ} (x y : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) :
    lieAct R 𝔤 n ⁅x, y⁆ f =
      lieAct R 𝔤 n x (lieAct R 𝔤 n y f) - lieAct R 𝔤 n y (lieAct R 𝔤 n x f)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem lieAct_zero (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 0) : lieAct R 𝔤 0 x f = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.map_cons_cons_swap
statement:
theorem map_cons_cons_swap {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 2)) (a b : 𝔤) (w : Fin n → 𝔤) :
    ω (Fin.cons a (Fin.cons b w)) = -ω (Fin.cons b (Fin.cons a w))

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.map_cons_removeNth
statement:
theorem map_cons_removeNth {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (v : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ω (Fin.cons (v i) (Fin.removeNth i v)) = koszulSign ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) • ω v

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_ceCocycles_one
statement:
theorem mem_ceCocycles_one {ω : CECochain R 𝔤 1} :
    ω ∈ ceCocycles R 𝔤 1 ↔ ∀ x y : 𝔤, ω ![⁅x, y⁆] = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_dualAnnihilator_derivedSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_dualAnnihilator_derivedSubmodule (φ : Module.Dual R 𝔤) :
    φ ∈ (derivedSubmodule R 𝔤).dualAnnihilator ↔ ∀ x y : 𝔤, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.removeNth_succ_cons
statement:
theorem removeNth_succ_cons {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (a : 𝔤) (y : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    Fin.removeNth j.succ (Fin.cons a y : Fin (n + 2) → 𝔤) = Fin.cons a (Fin.removeNth j y)

name: DG.cohomology.component_fromDirectSum
statement:
theorem component_fromDirectSum (n : ℤ) (x : ⨁ i, cohomology (M i) n) (j : ι) :
    component M j n (fromDirectSum M n x) = x j

name: DG.cohomology.component_mk
statement:
theorem component_mk (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (⨁ i, M i) n) :
    component M i n (mk _ n z) = mk _ n ⟨(z : ⨁ i, M i) i, mem_cocycles.mpr
      ⟨(DirectSum.mem_grading M).mp (cocycles.mem_grading z) i,
        by rw [← DirectSum.coe_d_apply, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, DirectSum.zero_apply]⟩⟩

name: DG.cohomology.component_ofSummand_of_ne
statement:
theorem component_ofSummand_of_ne {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) (n : ℤ) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    component M j n (ofSummand M i n y) = 0

name: DG.cohomology.component_ofSummand_self
statement:
theorem component_ofSummand_self (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    component M i n (ofSummand M i n y) = y

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_apply (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology (⨁ i, M i) n) (j : ι) :
    directSumAddEquiv M n x j = component M j n x

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_map_lof
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_map_lof (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    directSumAddEquiv M n (map (DGModuleHom.lof A M i) n y) = DirectSum.of _ i y

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_ofSummand
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_ofSummand (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    directSumAddEquiv M n (ofSummand M i n y) = DirectSum.of _ i y

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℤ) (x : ⨁ i, cohomology (M i) n) :
    (directSumAddEquiv M n).symm x = fromDirectSum M n x

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_symm_of
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_symm_of (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    (directSumAddEquiv M n).symm (DirectSum.of _ i y) = ofSummand M i n y

name: DG.cohomology.fromDirectSum_injective
statement: theorem fromDirectSum_injective (n : ℤ) : Function.Injective (fromDirectSum M n)

name: DG.cohomology.fromDirectSum_of
statement:
theorem fromDirectSum_of (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    fromDirectSum M n (DirectSum.of _ i y) = ofSummand M i n y

name: DG.cohomology.fromDirectSum_surjective
statement: theorem fromDirectSum_surjective (n : ℤ) : Function.Surjective (fromDirectSum M n)

name: DG.cohomology.map_lof
statement:
theorem map_lof (n : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    map (DGModuleHom.lof A M i) n = ofSummand M i n

name: DG.cohomology.ofSummand_mk
statement:
theorem ofSummand_mk (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (M i) n) :
    ofSummand M i n (mk _ n z) = mk _ n ⟨DirectSum.of M i z, mem_cocycles.mpr
      ⟨DirectSum.of_mem_grading M i (cocycles.mem_grading z),
        by rw [DirectSum.d_of, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, _root_.map_zero]⟩⟩

name: DG.DGBimodule.rightMulCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightMulCochain_apply {n : ℤ} (b : grading (M := B) n) (x : M) :
    rightMulCochain A M b x = signedRightMul M n (b : B) x

name: DG.DGBimodule.signedRightMul_add
statement:
theorem signedRightMul_add (n : ℤ) (b b' : B) :
    signedRightMul M n (b + b') = signedRightMul M n b + signedRightMul M n b'

name: DG.DGBimodule.signedRightMul_of_mem
statement:
theorem signedRightMul_of_mem (n : ℤ) (b : B) {j : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading j) :
    signedRightMul M n b x = koszulSign (n * j) • (op b • x)

name: DG.DGBimodule.signedRightMul_zero
statement: theorem signedRightMul_zero (n : ℤ) : signedRightMul M n (0 : B) = 0

name: DG.DGModule.END.decompose_op_smul
statement:
theorem decompose_op_smul (F : END A M) (n : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    (decompose (grading (M := M)) (op F • x) (i + n) : M) = koszulSign (n * i) • F n x

name: DG.DGModule.END.eq_of_op_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_op_smul_eq {m₀ : M} (hgen : ∀ x : M, ∃ a : A, a • m₀ = x) {F G : END A M}
    (h : op F • m₀ = op G • m₀) : F = G

name: DG.DGModule.END.ext_op_smul
statement: theorem ext_op_smul {F G : END A M} (h : ∀ x : M, op F • x = op G • x) : F = G

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_d_smul
statement:
theorem op_d_smul {j : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading j) (F : END A M) :
    op (d F) • x = koszulSign j • (d (op F • x) - op F • d x)

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_of_smul
statement:
theorem op_of_smul {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M n) {i : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    op (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n f) • x = koszulSign (n * i) • f x

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_smul_eq_rightAction
statement:
theorem op_smul_eq_rightAction (F : END A M) (x : M) :
    op F • x = (rightAction A M F).unop x

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_smul_eq_signedEval
statement: theorem op_smul_eq_signedEval (F : END A M) (x : M) : op F • x = signedEval A M F x

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_smul_injective
statement: theorem op_smul_injective : Function.Injective fun F : END A M => (op F • · : M → M)

name: DG.coe_decompose_map
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_map {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [DGAddCommGroup N] (f : M →+ N) (hf : ∀ {i : ℤ} {x : M}, x ∈ grading i → f x ∈ grading i)
    (x : M) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := N)) (f x) n : N) = f (decompose (grading (M := M)) x n)

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_idem : (idem e : A) = e.val

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.decompose_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) a n : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.smul_idem
statement: theorem smul_idem (x : e.LeftCorner) : (x : A) • idem e = x

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.val_smul_idem
statement: theorem val_smul_idem : e.val • idem e = idem e

name: DG.Cochain.apply_eq_smul_map_one
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.Cochain.apply_eq_smul_map_one {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) {i : ℤ} {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) : f x = koszulSign (n * i) • (x • f 1)

name: DG.Cochain.map_one_mem
statement: theorem _root_.DG.Cochain.map_one_mem {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) : f 1 ∈ grading (M := P) n

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.coevalOne_evalOne
statement: theorem coevalOne_evalOne (F : HOM A A P) : coevalOne A P (evalOne A P F) = F

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.coevalOne_of_mem
statement:
theorem coevalOne_of_mem {n : ℤ} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading n) :
    coevalOne A P p = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A P n) n (smulRightCochain ⟨p, hp⟩)

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.d_of_smul_of
statement:
theorem d_of_smul_of {k n : ℤ} (F : Cochain A M M k) (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    d ((DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P)) =
      d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
          (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P) +
        koszulSign k • ((DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
          d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P))

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem {k : ℤ} {x : HOM A M P} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) k (x k)

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOne_coevalOne
statement: theorem evalOne_coevalOne (p : P) : evalOne A P (coevalOne A P p) = p

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOne_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalOne_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) :
    evalOne A P (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A P n) n f) = f 1

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.instGmodule_eq_toGmodule
statement:
theorem instGmodule_eq_toGmodule :
    instGmodule A M M = DirectSum.GSemiring.toGmodule (fun n => Cochain A M M n)

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.of_smul_of
statement:
theorem of_smul_of {k n : ℤ} (F : Cochain A M M k) (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P) =
      DirectSum.of _ (k + n) (koszulSign (k * n) • f.comp F rfl)

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcompAddHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompAddHom_of (h : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P') {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    postcompAddHom M h (DirectSum.of _ n f) =
      DirectSum.of _ n ((Cochain.ofHom h).comp f (add_zero n))

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcompEND_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompEND_of (h : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P') {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    postcompEND M h (DirectSum.of _ n f) =
      DirectSum.of _ n ((Cochain.ofHom h).comp f (add_zero n))

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.smulRightCochain_apply
statement:
theorem smulRightCochain_apply {n : ℤ} (p : grading (M := P) n) (x : A) :

name: DG.ComplexTensor.associator_hom_f_tmul
statement:
theorem associator_hom_f_tmul {p q r pq n : ℤ} (hpq : p + q = pq) (h : pq + r = n) (x : K.X p)
    (y : L.X q) (z : M.X r) :
    (α_ K L M).hom.f n (tmul (K ⊗ L) M h (tmul K L hpq x y) z) =
      tmul K (L ⊗ M) (show p + (q + r) = n by omega) x (tmul L M rfl y z)

name: DG.ComplexTensor.d_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    (K ⊗ L).d n (n + 1) (tmul K L h x y) =
      tmul K L (show p + 1 + q = n + 1 by omega) (K.d p (p + 1) x) y +
        p.negOnePow • tmul K L (show p + (q + 1) = n + 1 by omega) x (L.d q (q + 1) y)

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tensorDesc_f_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorDesc_f_tmul (f : ∀ (p q n : ℤ), p + q = n → K.X p →ₗ[R] L.X q →ₗ[R] M.X n)
    (hf : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q),
      M.d n (n + 1) (f p q n h x y) =
        f (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega) (K.d p (p + 1) x) y +
          p.negOnePow • f p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega) x (L.d q (q + 1) y))
    {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    (tensorDesc K L M f hf).f n (tmul K L h x y) = f p q n h x y

name: DG.DGModuleCat.actBilin_leibniz
statement:
theorem actBilin_leibniz (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (a : (complex A).X p)
    (m : (toComplex R N).X q) :
    (toComplex R N).d n (n + 1) (actBilin N p q n h a m) =
      actBilin N (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega) ((complex A).d p (p + 1) a) m +
        p.negOnePow •
          actBilin N p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega) a ((toComplex R N).d q (q + 1) m)

name: DG.ModObj.assoc_apply
statement:
theorem assoc_apply {p q r n : ℤ} (h : p + q + r = n) (a : (toMonObj A).X.X p)
    (b : (toMonObj A).X.X q) (x : P.X.X r) :
    (ModObj.act P).f n (tmul _ P.X h ((μ[(toMonObj A).X]).f (p + q) (tmul _ _ rfl a b)) x) =
      (ModObj.act P).f n (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X (show p + (q + r) = n by omega) a
        ((ModObj.act P).f (q + r) (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X rfl b x)))

name: DG.exists_list_sum_eq_of_isSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem exists_list_sum_eq_of_isSemisimpleRing [IsSemisimpleRing R] {g : R}
    (hg : IsIdempotentElem g) :
    ∃ l : List R, (∀ s ∈ l, IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsSimpleModule R (Submodule.span R {s}) ∧
      s * g = s ∧ g * s = s) ∧ l.Pairwise (fun a b => a * b = 0 ∧ b * a = 0) ∧ l.sum = g
